channel.title: Bryan County News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Bryan County News (bryancountynews.com)

item.title: Bryan County Commissioner opposed to neighboring wastewater treatment plan
item.description: The Liberty County Development Authority is dusting off plans for a wastewater treatment facility — and it’s leading to a dust up with a neighboring county.

item.title: State property tax cut proposal fails
item.description: The Georgia House of Representatives rejected a proposal to nearly eliminate homeowner property taxes. The Republican-driven measure would have put a constitutional amendment to voters. To get on the ballot, it required support from some Democrats to win the necessary two-thirds majority.

item.title: Fifth annual Gullah Geechee Festival coming up in RH
item.description: The David Boles Foundation will co-host the fifth annual Gullah Geechee Festival supported by the City of Richmond Hill. This festival highlights the culture (food, music, religion, societal norms, etc.) of the local descendants of the local rice plantations. The Geechees are the formerly enslaved people in Georgia. The name is derived from the Ogeechee River. The festival will take place at J. F. Gregory Park on March 28, from noon until 6 p.m.

item.title: Legion's Spring Food Drive is on March 14
item.description: American Legion JE Lanier Post 27 is hosting its Spring Food Drive on Saturday, March 14 from 10 a.m. to noon at the DeVaul Henderson Park Shell Station, 22 Capt. Matthew Freeman Drive in Richmond Hill.

item.title: STAR students recognized by school district, local Lions Club
item.description: Richmond Hill High School seniors Elizabeth Latimer and Delaney Thompson have been named the RHHS and Bryan County School System 2026 PAGE STAR Students.

item.title: Savannah Music Festival Director visits Rotary Club
item.description: On Thursday, the Rotary Club of Richmond Hill welcomed Sinisa Ciric, Executive Director of the Savannah Music Festival (SMF), to speak about the annual musical arts festival, now in its 37th year.

item.title: Bryan County's Jasmine Mikell crowned Region 3A-DII Player of the Year
item.description: For the fourth straight year a Bryan County girl has been named the region Player of the Year as Region 3A-DII coaches voted senior guard Jasmine Mikell the region’s most outstanding player.

item.title: Baseball: Dominant Lowndes defeat Wildcats
item.description: The Trojans swept Richmond Hill in their 3-game region series by winning both games Friday, 10-3 and 3-0.

item.title: GCAT swimmers win gold at Georgia Short Course Age Group Championship
item.description: Members of Georgia Coastal Aquatic Team (GCAT) traveled to Columbus, Georgia on February 20 for the 2026 Georgia Short Course Age Group Championship.

item.title: Bryan County couple found shot to death in their home
item.description: A husband and wife were found dead in their home in northern Bryan County Sunday afternoon, and the man suspected of killing the couple killed himself during a chase with law enforcement.
